limitations: Tissue identity, cell types and staining interpretation are caption claims; the pixels show colors and patterns only. No scale bar is visible.
Panel D shows glandular mucosal tissue, different from the panel C spindle cell tissue, and its caption wording about cancer cells is not explained by the text; the pixels are described only as seen.
